title: Live: Pope Leo XIV holds open-air Mass at Lourdes pilgrimage site
summary: Pope Leo XIV is visiting the pilgrimage town of Lourdes this weekend as part of his four-day trip to France, the first official papal state visit to the country in 18 years.
